name: CHEVRON_ALIGNMENT_3_YELLOW_WIDE
notes: Three black 45-degree chevron bands on yellow: bands 250 wide horizontally (177 perpendicular) with boundaries at 25 + 250k along the top/bottom edges (25 | 250 x5 | 200 | 25), points 200 from the top/bottom edges (25 | 200 | 200 | 25) so each apex is offset 200 to the right. The final yellow chevron is clipped by the right border (its apex touches the border at mid-height). Drawn to the right (arrows point right); the standard uses the mirrored sign for the other direction but this PNG shows one hand only.
